prospect_qualification.score_contract: ICP 0-3 + evidence-bound agent opportunity 0-3 + active signal 0-2 + value/integration fit 0-2; A=8-10, B=6-7, C=0-5
quality_rules: A requires official evidence-bound fact and idea
generic contact-only is not automatically A
lead_reactivation A requires first-party approved dataset
qualification never creates compliance or send permission

campaign_gate.target_contract: one explicit approved agent type for prepare; auto is validate/exploration only

contact_enrichment.input_boundary: campaign-matching A-qualified AgentProspectQualifications plus qualified ProspectCandidates for campaign prepare; standalone legacy qualified-only workflow retained

zero_touch_prepare.flow: prospect_discovery -> prospect_candidate_sanitizer -> prospect_signal_discovery -> prospect_agent_qualification -> prospect_campaign_gate -> prospect_contact_enrichment_campaign -> prospect_intelligence -> private_outreach_config -> outreach_agent_prepare_v2
zero_touch_prepare.input_boundary: one explicit campaign agent target; only matching A-qualified ai_agent prospects with ContactCandidates.ready can produce value-flow copy
zero_touch_prepare.queue_contract: writes status=prepared, compliance_status=manual_review and blank compliance_basis; never creates approved/sendable state
zero_touch_prepare.copy_contract: campaign-first NL/EN value-flow copy; process subject; no default generic cases URL; no inferred price/ROI/guarantee; CTA A/B only; one follow-up
zero_touch_prepare.value_asset_contract: process_flow concept_ready value_asset_summary is stored in agent_offer evidence before contact/copy

sender_readiness.provider_managed_relay: provider_managed supported for proven shared mijn.host relay without per-IP/global-placement claims

outreach_delivery.live_gate: sender_readiness -> website target/evidence -> LeadPromo copy -> compliance -> SMTP
outreach_delivery.target_evidence_contract: agent_offer:<JSON> canonical evidence; website_scan:<JSON> legacy evidence; official target rechecked before SMTP
outreach_delivery.private_config_contract: private physical postal address loaded at runtime; no plaintext repository variable

boundaries: Leadscanner executes bounded Leads policy; it is not a second process controller.
Scheduled prospect discovery remains validate-only unless PROSPECT_DISCOVERY_ENABLED=true explicitly promotes the scheduled run to discover mode.
Campaign-first prepare requires one explicit approved agent target; auto is validate/exploration only.
Campaign audit is read-only and never rewrites canonical ProspectCandidates state.
Campaign-aware contact enrichment searches email only for campaign-matching A-qualified prospects.
Default v13.1 agent outreach stores a process_flow value asset and contains no generic portfolio/cases URL.
A light official process read is normal; full website evidence scan is not required for every prospect.
No prospect pain, volume, revenue, ROI, price or result is invented.
Agent prepare writes only prepared/manual_review with blank compliance_basis and no mailbox credentials.
NL/EER live outreach still requires separately evidenced valid compliance basis.
Reply, bounce and opt-out stop follow-up state.
No secret belongs in repository, Sheet evidence fields, logs, fixtures or artifacts.
